data.name: Ghufaira
data.gender_notes: Ghufaira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Ghufaira means 'a radiant light' or 'a shining star'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'ghafara' which means 'to be pure, clean, and free from sin'. In Islamic tradition, Ghufaira is a beautiful name for a girl, often associated with spiritual purity and inner radiance. The name Ghufaira carries the meaning “A Radiant Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghufaira usually hope their child will grow to embody a radiant light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the beauty and fragrance of the soul, and the gentle nature of the person
data.etymology: Ghufaira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A Radiant Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghufaira total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
